mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (id, reservation_id, user_id, hotel_id, rating, cleanliness_rating, kindness_rating, content, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{reservationId}, #{userId}, #{hotelId}, #{rating}, #{cleanlinessRating}, #{kindnessRating}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT rv.id AS id, h.id AS hotelId, h.name AS hotelName, rv.rating AS rating, rv.cleanliness_rating AS cleanlinessRating, rv.kindness_rating AS kindnessRating, rv.content AS content, rv.created_at AS createdAt FROM reviews rv JOIN hotels h ON h.id = rv.hotel_id WHERE rv.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rv.created_at DESC
SELECT reservation_id FROM reviews WHERE user_id = #{userId}
